    The gauge on odd quotients of even A (Lemma A.1(2)) #

    lem:periodic-scalar-gauges (2), periodic-mesh-calculations.tex: "For the odd even-A quotient, first keep the scales of the arrows ε_j equal to one and choose the root mesh scales to normalize the coefficients of ε_{j-2} ε_{j-1}. The recurrence on each arm edge advances j by two. … Its product equation determines the next vertex's mesh-scaling product, and the same recursion finishes the normalization."

    Vertices of A_{2h} are indexed by their depth d ∈ [0, 2h) from one end; the middle edge is {h - 1, h}, and the deck generator is (d, s) ↦ (2h - 1 - d, s + c₀) with c₀ odd. The coefficients are recorded by C a b s (the coefficient at (a, s + 2) of the arrow from (b, s + 1)). We solve the equations on the half d ≥ h and fold the other half onto it.
